title: Pottery
description:
Free and open to the public, adults and kids with an adult! This is the time to come and develop your creative skills among friends. We've got tools and volunteers to help with all kinds of pottery projects. Here are a few to get you thinking about what you'd like to try:

-   Hand built sculpture
-   Slab rolling
-   Coil pots
-   Wheel thrown

Bring in a project you’d like to work on or an idea of what you'd like to try and we'll do what we can to help bring it to life.  
Please tie your hair back, trim your fingernails, and wear clothes that can get muddy.

Please note that the metal shop will be unavailable during the Open House.
